name: StagingBar - Publish Again While Deploying
description: The state that used to be impossible: a deploy in flight and a fresh change ready to publish at the same time. Both pills are the assertion — the chip is the first publish still deploying, the bar below is a second edit staged since, with 'Review & publish' live rather than blocked. Publishing was previously a phase the component sat in until Pages finished, so a second publish had to wait out the first. The watch now lives beside the publish flow rather than inside it.
